account_profile_meta_description: Your name, your password and, for partners, the IBAN your commission is paid to, all on one page.
account_profile_header_line_partner: Set your name, your password and the IBAN your commission is paid to, right here.
account_profile_header_line_customer: Set your name and your password right here.
account_profile_name_line: {trainer} will call you by this name.
account_profile_password_line_set: You can also sign in with your number and password. Forgot it? Sign in with a text code and set a new password right here.
account_profile_password_line_none: Set a password to sign in without waiting for a text message. You can always sign in with a text code too.
account_profile_password_description: At least {min} characters. Your mobile number and very simple passwords aren't accepted.
account_profile_password_sign_in_again: Sign out and sign in again
account_profile_sheba_line: {trainer} pays your commission into this IBAN.
account_profile_sheba_notice: You haven't entered an IBAN yet; it's needed for your commission to be paid.
account_profile_sheba_description: The 24 digits after IR, with or without spaces. Persian digits work too.
account_profile_voice_intro_name: Spell your name right so {trainer} knows who you are.
account_profile_voice_intro_password: Set a password and next time you can come straight in, no text needed.
account_profile_voice_intro_sheba: Enter your IBAN so {trainer} can send your commission.
account_profile_voice_error: Something's not right. Check the red ones.
account_profile_schema_sheba_format: An IBAN (Sheba number) starts with IR, followed by 24 digits.
account_profile_schema_sheba_checksum: This IBAN isn't right; check it again.
account_profile_schema_password_min: The password must be at least {min} characters.
account_profile_schema_password_max: The password can be at most {max} characters.
account_profile_error_signed_out: You've been signed out. Refresh the page and sign in again.
account_profile_error_too_many: There were too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
account_profile_error_network: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
account_profile_error_internal_ref: Couldn't save. Try again. Reference number: {id}
account_profile_error_sheba_check: Couldn't save. Check the IBAN and try again.
account_profile_error_sheba_forbidden: An IBAN can't be saved for this account. If you think that's a mistake, let {trainer} know.
account_profile_error_password_check: Couldn't save. Check the password and try again.
account_profile_error_session_too_old: For security, the password can only be changed within half an hour of signing in. Sign out, sign in again with a text code, and set the password right then.
account_profile_page_error_line: Something went wrong. Open the page again or check back in a few minutes.
